items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: his name was Bigfoot Bill... he joined our group and he helped us quite a bit.

ctx.x: I don't know what I've heard of. Yeah. Your picture in the frame. Well I remember that very well because of the fact that we used to open up all the dance engagements with it. And I used to close, so therefore I remembered it very much. And when he came down there he got some of the fellas from the band I had been working with at the time. And this band was comprised of fellas that used to go to school together, you know, and we called ourselves and at Crescent City I had us. And we more or less took care of all…
Yeah he still plays at a place called Lutyens.
